ram_read_latency: READ_LATENCY_B measured from generated BMG; parameterized, not assumed
credit_rule: new request allowed only when FIFO free capacity covers outstanding responses plus configured safety margin
steady_state_target: 1 request and 1 returned 128-bit word per clk_mem after fill when downstream accepts
output: natural 128-bit word stream plus lane valid mask/first/last/logical sequence metadata; no cross-word compaction
abort: STOP_ISSUE -> drain/discard in-flight responses -> clear FIFO -> return token; never release bank with unknown responses
